content.body: Your blood pressure was estimated at 128/84 mmHg with a heart rate of around 72 bpm. A normal range sits below 120 over 80. This is a screening signal and not a diagnosis. Please see a doctor within 7 days so they can confirm the reading with a proper cuff.
